text:
omar (AE): ApexAI POC hitting throttles — started ~10:12 PT. Customer says 429s after sustained traffic. Can we triage?

sarah (AM): Seen similar when client hits per-key QPS. Do we have logs?

james (SE): Sending a quick curl they ran, looks fine on their side but we see repeats of 429s.
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-***' -d '{"input":"..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

tina (SRE): Runtime shows a bunch of rejects from rate_limiter with reason=quota_exceeded. snippet: 
```
[2026-03-19T17:12:07Z] rate_limiter: reject user=apex-poc key=sk-*** bucket=global qps=2000 limit=1500
[2026-03-19T17:12:08Z] serve: fallback route invoked -> model-llama-13b-quant-fallback
```

omar (AE): They were expecting to push a steady 2k rps for the demo. Is that exceeding our free/credit caps? Pricing was discussed but not final.

james (SE): Two likely things: 1) client is not honoring exponential backoff and hammering on retries, 2) they're using a single API key and hit per-key throttle. We can provide guidance + temporary quota bump for the demo.

lena (security): Also FYI customer has outstanding security questionnaire (SOC2 + network topology). They asked for IP allowlist and data residency confirmation before VPC. I can send the packet if I get the contact.

apex-poc-admin: @omar thanks — we were doing a load script, didn't add jitter. Demo timeline is today 14:00 PT. If there's anything we need to do on our side we can change quickly.

sarah (AM): Ok timeline tight. Priorities: stabilize demo (no 429), confirm security doc, and decide pricing path for sustained throughput.

tina (SRE): Quick mitigation options:
- temporary per-project burst increase (10m window)
- enable request-level rate smoothing (server-side token bucket tweak)
- route traffic to Dedicated trial pool if customer is ok to spin one up (30m)

james (SE): Also can change client to use 4 parallel keys (short-term) which spreads per-key caps. Not ideal but works for demo. I'll send a small patch to their load script with jitter + retry-with-backoff.

omar (AE): Can infra do a temporary bump? If yes, what info do you need?

tina (SRE): I can bump project-level QPS from 1500 -> 3500 for 20 minutes. Need: project_id, requested window start/end, and the client IP ranges if you want IP-based exceptions.

omar (AE): Project id: apex-prod-poctest-01. Window: 2026-03-19T21:55Z -> 2026-03-19T22:20Z (that covers demo). IPs: 54.187.12.0/24 and 34.201.56.101.

tina (SRE): Got it. I'll enqueue change and post deploy-bot note when active. ETA ~6m.

deploy-bot: scheduled config change: project=apex-prod-poctest-01 qps=3500 window=25m by tina at 2026-03-19T17:20:10Z

james (SE): Patch for load script posted to their sandbox repo with jitter and exponential backoff. snippet: 
```js
// pseudo
const wait = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms))
async function callWithBackoff(req, attempts=5){
  for(let i=0;i<attempts;i++){
    let res = await fetch(req)
    if(res.status === 429){
      await wait(Math.pow(2,i)*100 + Math.random()*100)
      continue
    }
    return res
  }
}
```

apex-poc-admin: We applied the patch and added jitter. Demo run at 14:02 looked much better — only a couple transient 429s. Thanks.

lena (security): For the security packet: sending SOC2 attestation + IP allowlist doc to apex-contacts@apexai.com. Also need a signed NDA addendum for on-prem templates — Omar can you confirm contact?

omar (AE): Will send NDA to legal@apexai and loop you.

sarah (AM): Pricing note: sustained 2k rps at their token sizes will push them into a reserved-capacity conversation. We should follow up with a quote and the Dedicated trial option.

james (SE): One more thing — model fallback in logs indicates we momentarily routed to smaller quantized model. That reduced latency but changed outputs slightly. If they care about parity we should pin model version for the demo.

apex-poc-admin: Output differences were acceptable for the demo. We'll want parity for production.

tina (SRE): Postmortem steps:
- I applied the temporary QPS bump and enabled per-project smoothing.
- I'll monitor errors for 1h and roll back if anything odd.
- Create a follow-up ticket to evaluate Dedicated trial for sustained load.

omar (AE): Next actions assigned:
- tina: monitor + confirm rollback window (ETA 1h)
- james: share load-script patch + recommended client config (done)
- lena: send security packet (in flight)
- sarah: pricing quote + Dedicated trial proposal by EOD
- omar: send NDA contact to lena and update customer comms now

sarah (AM): :thumbsup: I'll draft the quote and ping sales-ops for a provisional Dedicated SKU.

apex-poc-admin: Big thanks team — demo got green check from execs. We'll reconvene tomorrow for next steps.

tina (SRE): Monitoring shows 429 rate dropping to near zero after changes. I'll close the immediate war-room but keep ticket open.

omar (AE): Great job everyone. Closing thread — will follow up in sales sync with outcomes. 🔁
